summary: Most of the frustration centres on account restrictions and security concerns, followed by positive user experience and poor customer support. Users report sudden account freezes, restrictions, and difficulty accessing funds, raising concerns about security and transparency in account management and transaction processing.

themes.name: Trust and Transparency Issues
themes.description: Users express skepticism about the company's motives, especially regarding fee structures, referral programs, and data privacy.
themes.recommendation: Improve transparency around fees, data usage, and business practices to build user trust.

themes.name: Account Restrictions and Security Concerns
themes.description: Users report sudden account freezes, restrictions, and difficulty accessing funds, raising concerns about security and transparency in account management and transaction processing.
themes.recommendation: Improve account security transparency and provide clearer communication during account restrictions.
